newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Laserlight to take 11 pct of CCT Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Laserlight to take 11 pct of CCT Telecom.

text.p: CCT Telecom Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday independent third party Laserlight Ltd would hold 11.1 percent of CCT's enlarged share capital after Laserlight exercised HK$40 million in convertible bonds.

The telecommunications equipment maker said it would issue 153.85 million new shares to Laserlight after the bond holder exercised the full amount of the bonds, convertible into company shares at an adjusted conversion price of HK$0.26 each.
Apart from the bonds, Laserlight holds no interest in the company, CCT said in a statement.
In September, the company issued HK$40 million worth of convertible bonds, raising funds to repay bank loans and for research and development.
CCT shares fell HK$0.005 to HK$0.450 at midday Wednesday.
